statement: The inspected SDL2 branch at commit 8acf7cfc0f88717e5c036f60f0314bfcafe39189 lists legacy Valve PIDs 1101/1102/1105/1106/1142/1201/1202/1205 but no 28de:1302 in controller_list.h lines 592-603; SDL_hidapi_steam.c 952-993 uses SDL_IsJoystickSteamController and a default-disabled Steam HIDAPI hint. Inferred that its inspected native Steam driver does not explicitly select Triton 1302. Whether the Linux SDL2 evdev fallback accepts a generic 1302 device: No evidence. No claim of absent support in all SDL2 versions.
